A small update to **ByteExplorer** 1.0.

## What's new

- **Support ByteExplorer on Ko-fi:** Settings › About now has a link to the author's [Ko-fi page](https://ko-fi.com/eliquin081), for anyone who'd like to say thanks. Like every link in the app, it opens in your browser only when you click it.

## Download

| System | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11 (64-bit)** | `ByteExplorer-1.0.1-win-x64.zip` | Unzip it anywhere and run `ByteExplorer.exe`. |
| **Linux (64-bit)** | `ByteExplorer-1.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf ByteExplorer-1.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz`, then `./ByteExplorer-1.0.1-linux-x64/ByteExplorer` |

Nothing else to install: .NET is included in both.

- **Windows:** the program isn't code-signed yet, so the first start may show *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Video and music previews (VLC) are included.
- **Linux:** for video and music previews install VLC from your distribution (`sudo apt install vlc`, not the Flatpak or Snap); see the [README](https://github.com/Eliquin/ByteExplorer-public#video-and-music-previews-vlc).
- **macOS:** no build yet; it can be built from source (experimental, see below).
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` checks the downloads. `vlc-3.0.21.tar.xz` is VLC's source code, published because the Windows build includes VLC (LGPL/GPL); you don't need it.

ByteExplorer never connects to the internet on its own and never updates itself: new versions are published here.

## Tested platforms

- **Windows (64-bit): tested and working.** ByteExplorer is built and used by its author on Windows 10; Windows 11 is
  supported too.
- **Linux (64-bit): tested and working.** The full automated test suite (600+ tests) runs on Linux, and the release
  build was started and checked on Ubuntu 24.04. Reports from different distributions and desktops (GNOME, KDE,
  Xfce, …) are welcome.
- **macOS: experimental and untested.** The code supports macOS (Trash, volumes, VLC.app), but it hasn't been run on a
  Mac yet and no macOS build is published. Expect rough edges; [bug reports](https://github.com/Eliquin/ByteExplorer-public/issues)
  are very welcome.

See the [1.0.0 release](https://github.com/Eliquin/ByteExplorer-public/releases/tag/v1.0.0) for the full list of features.
